title: gnaphalium spathulatum
intro: Gnaphalium spathulatum, commonly known as Western Yarrow or Western Wormwood, is a type of flowering plant native to the western regions of North America. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium spathulatum include its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as insomnia, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
